IGUI_WQ_NoReclamable: This place can no longer be claimed
IGUI_WQ_Locura: %1 lost their mind and fled %2 with supplies
IGUI_WQ_Panel_SinTerritorio: You have no territories. Claim one with right click.
IGUI_WQ_Panel_Estructuras: Structures: %1 beds, %2 farm plots, %3 stoves, %4 generators
IGUI_WQ_Panel_Selecciona: Click a colonist to see their sheet
IGUI_WQ_Panel_Tirada: Narrator tension: %1 (next roll: %2 percent; rolls every %3 min)
IGUI_WQ_Pista_reclamar: Right-click the ground to claim a territory. Your colony starts there.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_almacen: Mark a piece of furniture with storage space as the colony storage: food and materials are kept there.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_colonos: Once you have a storage, survivors will come to your colony asking for shelter.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_roles: A colonist without a role does nothing. Give them one in the Colonists tab of the Command center.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_hambre: Your colonists are hungry. They eat whatever is in the storage.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_obras: Your builders can raise buildings. Check the Buildings tab.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_mejorar: You can upgrade your colony now. Check the Colony tab of the Command center.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_crisis: A crisis has been announced. The Command center shows how long until it arrives.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Mejorar: Upgrades the colony to the next level. Uses the materials in the storage.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Nivel: The size of your colony. Each level enlarges the territory and allows more colonists.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_DeOtro: This colony belongs to another player. You can look, but you can't give orders.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Cupo: Colonists in the colony and how many fit. Each bed adds a spot, up to the level's limit.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Comida: Food in the storages. Colonists eat from here.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Materiales: Planks, nails and logs in the storages. Spent on upgrades and buildings.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Estructuras: What is inside the territory. Beds raise the capacity; stoves and generators cheer colonists up; farm plots help the farmer.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Defensa: How well the colony holds against a raid. Raised by guards, each colonist's combat and some buildings.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Siguiente: To level up you need these materials in the storage and a minimum number of colonists.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_SinColonos: Survivors come to colonies that have a storage and free space.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Animo: If it reaches zero, the colonist leaves. It rises when they eat well and drops with hunger.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Rol: What they do each cycle: the farmer harvests, the builder gathers logs or raises buildings, the scout brings loot at a risk, the guard defends and the doctor cheers people up.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Hambre: Time without food. If it continues, they lose mood and end up leaving.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Habilidades: They improve by working in their role. The highlighted one is their specialty.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Construir: Starts the building and spends its materials right away. Builders raise it.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_EnObra: Progresses every cycle depending on your builders. Without builders, it stops.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_torre: Warns earlier about announced crises and adds defense.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_taller: Builders gather twice as many logs.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_muralla: Shrinks hordes and adds a lot of defense.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_radio: Attracts more survivors asking for shelter.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Tension: Each roll without a crisis raises the tension and the chance of the next one. It grows with the size of the largest colony.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Pendiente: An announced crisis. Get ready before it arrives.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Frio: Dangerous cold inside the territory. Dress warmly or find heat.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_AbrirMapa: Opens the world map centered on this colony.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_FilaMapa: Click to see it on the map.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_SinPistas: The tips that appear while you play are kept here.
